caseNameFull: Dunbar v. McNeill, Superintendent, Matteawan State Hospital
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Louis J. Lefko-witz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and Joseph J. Rose, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
